candidates.description: This vector represents psychoactive substances, medications, and related chemical compounds.
This feature vector activates on terms related to pharmacology, medicine, and drug-related concepts.
This vector represents concepts related to illegal acts, law enforcement, and the criminal justice system.
This feature vector represents medical conditions, health-related terms, and demographic groups.
This feature vector represents common adverbial and nominal suffixes across Romance languages, primarily forming adverbs of manner and abstract nouns.
This feature vector represents linguistic roots and morphological stems shared across multiple languages and grammatical contexts.
This feature vector represents linguistic roots and affixes associated with prevalence, dominance, and recurrence across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on anatomical, medical, and physiological prefixes and terms.
This feature vector represents Spanish and Latin-derived verbal suffixes and inflectional morphemes associated with past participles and related grammatical forms.
This vector represents common phonetic syllables and consonant-vowel sounds frequently found in human language.
